risk_if_not_implemented: Without Programming Language Selection, security, compliance and resilience activities may lack direction, ownership and executive support, leaving required controls unperformed. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Inability to Demonstrate Due Diligence / Due Care (R-GV-9), and most likely increases susceptibility to Dysfunctional Management Practices (MT-8), Human Error (MT-9).

compensating_control_1.name: Secure Software Development Practices (SSDP)
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to develop applications based on Secure Software Development Practices (SSDP).
compensating_control_1.justification: Secure Software Development Practices (SSDP) (TDA-05) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Programming Language Selection (TDA-04.1) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Software Usage Restrictions
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to enforce software usage restrictions to comply with applicable contract agreements and copyright laws.
compensating_control_2.justification: Software Usage Restrictions (CFG-11) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Programming Language Selection (TDA-04.1) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
